title: FEARFILES: THE PHOTO
endSub: How many are in YOUR photo?

cta.text: SOME STORIES FIND YOU. SUBSCRIBE FIRST.

lines.text: Don't count the people in your Thanksgiving photo.
We took ours on the porch. Seven of us.
Mom posted it. Grandma zoomed in.
Behind my uncle stood a pale woman. Smiling.
Nobody knew her. Nobody saw her that night.
So I checked the timer photos. All twelve.
In every one, she was a step closer to me.
In the last one, her hand was on my shoulder.
Then my phone buzzed. A new photo, uploading.
Our family, on the porch. Eight of them.
And I'm not one of them.
So count again. How many are in yours?
